source.research_status: EXPOSED_DEV; NO NEW PHYSICAL ACTION; NO REPRISTINATION

method.unit: one original independent actor/seed/environment episode; groups NEVER pool two actors or resets
method.L0_key: (current original public before SHA256, chosen original action ID 0..6)
method.Lk_key: (current original public before SHA256, chosen original action, previous L chronological pairs of (source public before SHA256, actually selected action)). Both observation and action are retained. Initial fewer-than-L steps are excluded for equal-length comparison at that L.
method.outcome: exact returned public after SHA256 after real selected action; equal hashes are equal public observations only
method.repeat_key_definition: same L-dependent key selected >=2 times in one episode
method.conflicting_key_definition: same L-dependent key selected >=2 times in one original episode but returned >=2 distinct after-public SHA256 values
method.conflicting_key_event_count: total original selected events belonging to ambiguous keys; not unique conflicts or independently randomized trials
method.exactness: SHA256 equality of canonical full original public observation is necessary to mark same public, not approximate camera image comparison
method.qualification_note: No new predictor fitted; this is source information sufficiency and repeated sample coverage. Hash uniqueness at long memory can eliminate observed conflict vacuously.
method.caveat: Identical current public observations may hide different world poses/inventory, stochasticity or unseen history; difference in returned public does not prove which hidden variable explains it.

interpretation.material_observation: Same selected original action from same full current public observation produces different returned public view within one episode in 61 contexts/33 episodes. Appending one prior original public+action pair reduces source-detected contradictions 61→17, two pairs to 6, four to 5, eight to 0 on only eligible historic events.
interpretation.support_loss: Number of events belonging to repeated exact context/action keys declines 11,799 at L=0 to 3,758 at L=8, despite fewer conflicting keys. This prevents equating zero training contradictions with predictability or out-of-source generalization.
interpretation.preexisting_overlap: Yggdrasil C34 #545 and other original public-history source research already study memory sufficiency. THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH NOVELTY FOR A NEW MULTISTEP LEARNER.
controls_for_future_prospective_protocol: matching L-history tabular and recurrent prediction controls
matched history length and source-selected data rights
source-current full visual vs prior action-only ablation
nonduplicated genuinely new source train/heldout identities
task reward and true original source actions primary; model predicts distinct decisions but no posthoc threshold tuning
interpretation.mechanism_gate: Even though a memory operation may be necessary on these states, a new native model is NOT justified until project owner demonstrates non-overlap with C34, R11 and existing original candidate archive and authentic sufficiently supported learnable public histories.

decision.next: Original native owner assesses already archived FIT history information sufficiency versus equally informed conventional history controls, identifies a substantially distinct learned operation only with evidence; no new original-world test until owner authorization and source-first frozen acceptance.
